title: Frontend: Sidebar
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Sidebar. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. A Toggle sidebar button toggles a nav aria-label=Workspace. It starts expanded. Links Dashboard and Reports must always keep accessible names; collapsed nav is absent from the DOM. aria-expanded and aria-controls must match. Escape on the toggle collapses it.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Keep collapsed state separate from current-route state.
alternativeApproaches: Persist only the layout preference and distinguish desktop collapse from mobile open state.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Collapse/expand; active route; mobile Escape.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
